description: This Java source file defines the AlertDialogSamples class, an Android Activity demonstrating various ways to create and display AlertDialogs, including simple message dialogs, list dialogs, progress dialogs, choice dialogs, and custom view dialogs. It includes handling for dialog creation, button interactions, and UI event wiring.

classes.name: AlertDialogSamples
classes.description: An Android Activity showcasing various dialog types using AlertDialogs, including message boxes, list selections, progress indicators, and custom views, with event handling for user interactions.

methods.name: onCreateDialog
methods.description: Creates and returns different types of AlertDialogs or ProgressDialogs based on the provided dialog ID. It configures dialog properties such as titles, buttons, items, and custom views.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the user interface, and binds button click listeners to show respective dialogs. Also initializes the handler for updating progress.

methods.name: onEnterAnimationComplete
methods.description: Logs a message when the activity's enter animation completes.
